_doc: Fixed paper-condition baseline protocol (Ahmed et al., arXiv 2409.06018). Runnable part = paper_effective (measured: case Dice 0.8868 +/- 0.0001, seeds 42/43/44, PR #13). PR #13 ran it with --set data.inner_val_cases=4 and eval.dice_average_unit=case; both are fixed here. Keys starting with '_' are records only and are not used by train/evaluate. See docs/experiments/baseline_protocol.md.
name: baseline_protocol

test_cases.source: SPIDER Lumbar Spine Segmentation Overview.csv, subset == validation

planned_all_series.filter: A90 / C / F reading (keeps almost all 4-class slices) + cap 1000 slices per sequence
planned_all_series.test_split: Overview CSV validation cases per sequence (T1 38, T2 38, T2_SPACE 11)
